bank_credit_union.notes: Commercial bank branch (QCEW NAICS 522110). Scenario assumes no taxable retail sales. Typical FTE assumes one 40-hour FTE per job. Low and high use 75% and 125% of typical for each estimate. Local sales tax uses the 1% Bradley–Burns allocation before adjustments.

clinic.notes: Physician office (QCEW NAICS 621111). Scenario assumes no taxable retail sales. Typical FTE assumes one 40-hour FTE per job. Low and high use 75% and 125% of typical for each estimate. Local sales tax uses the 1% Bradley–Burns allocation before adjustments.

grocery.notes: Supermarket (QCEW NAICS 445110). Sales use San Francisco food and beverage store taxable transactions divided by average quarterly outlets. Typical FTE assumes one 40-hour FTE per job. Low and high use 75% and 125% of typical for each estimate. Local sales tax uses the 1% Bradley–Burns allocation before adjustments.

pharmacy.geography: San Francisco County staffing and California taxable sales
pharmacy.notes: Pharmacy (QCEW NAICS 456110). Sales use statewide pharmacy and drugstore taxable transactions divided by average quarterly permits as a proxy. Typical FTE assumes one 40-hour FTE per job. Low and high use 75% and 125% of typical for each estimate. Local sales tax uses the 1% Bradley–Burns allocation before adjustments.

school.notes: Local-government elementary or secondary school (QCEW NAICS 611110). Scenario assumes no taxable retail sales. Typical FTE assumes one 40-hour FTE per job. Low and high use 75% and 125% of typical for each estimate. Local sales tax uses the 1% Bradley–Burns allocation before adjustments.
